title: Docs: Skill Now Documents Singleton Block Rules

Fixed: The bundled skill.md now documents that gqlquery and gqlvariables are each allowed at most once per request section (independently of each other). Previously undocumented, which could lead an AI agent to insert duplicates of either block.

title: Headless Request-Build Merge Fix & Inline Block Help

Added: The Query and Variables blocks now show an inline "?" help tooltip in their header, matching the other request blocks
Fixed: Headless (CLI / voiden-mcp) GraphQL request building no longer discards headers contributed by another plugin's request-build handler (e.g. an auth-block header from voiden-advanced-auth) — the builder previously replaced the entire header set from scratch on every run, silently dropping anything set by a handler that ran earlier in the chain

Added: An "Open Documentation" item now appears in the right-click block menu for GraphQL Query, URL, Query Body, Variables, and Subscription Events blocks, opening the Voiden Blocks docs in your system browser

title: False Unsaved-Changes Fix & Manual Variable Sync

Added: A Resync button in the GraphQL Variables block — regenerates variables from the paired query on demand
Changed: Variables are no longer auto-synced from every keystroke while editing the query — typing passes through incomplete/intermediate variable names, and syncing on those could permanently reset a variable's value to a blank default even after the query text was corrected back. Variables now only update from an explicit query edit or a click of the Resync button
Resyncing variables after renaming a $variable in the query now carries its existing value over to the new name instead of resetting it to a type default
Fixed: Opening a .void file with a GraphQL request no longer immediately marks the tab as having unsaved changes — this had several causes: the variable-sync and operationType-correction effects ran on the very first mount (loading from disk), the variables block was reformatted on load even when its saved value was already valid, and the on-load vs. live-editor comparison itself had structural mismatches (attrs materialized with schema-default values, empty content arrays, and variables JSON key ordering) that made a freshly opened, unedited file compare as changed

Improved: AI skill documentation rewritten to accurately reflect the gqlquery container structure (gqlurl + gqlbody children), gqlsubscriptionevents node, correct block attr schemas with uid fields, and precise node hierarchy

Added: Block outline metadata for gqlquery, gqlvariables, and gqlsubscriptionevents so they display at their correct document positions with labels and previews in the Block Overview Panel

Fixed: gql-variable block now correctly pairs with its own gql-query in multi-request files separated by request-separator
Adding a new gql-variable block no longer updates the first gql-variable of another request
Editing a gql-query now immediately reflects variable changes in its paired gql-variable block
Schema viewer no longer crashes with circular type references — gracefully falls back to an error message
flushSync warning eliminated when inserting a new GraphQL query block
Remove catch-all shim from build pipeline for correct dependency bundling
Removed catch-all shim block that caused runtime import errors for bundled dependencies

title: Initial Release
description: GraphQL plugin for Voiden with introspection, variables, and schema explorer.
